Candidate search succeeds after the common search skill exits at 66%; two arms have identical normalized skill action sequences. Later model original tools complete search. This is not an observed benefit of the v9 extra-confirmation rule.

Both search_complete arms read cached progress 90 then 100 on periodic reads; candidate extra_reads is empty. Both execute the same skill actions; candidate asks one additional list_drones and uses more tokens.

Both unknown_takeoff arms have one exposed post-error model opportunity and recover remaining hover without any takeoff replay. Candidate has two input_json object type errors, including a status query after hover.

Actual usage totals are directly recomputed from 68 closed HTTP200 responses. Cache hit plus miss equals prompt tokens on all 68; cost accounting remains conservative peak/cache-miss, not supplier invoice.
Joint configuration, one repeat per known development condition. Byte/token changes and behavior changes are not isolated causes; no claim of stable improvement or unseen generalization.
